items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: And Basie said “I think we better get the hell out of here” you know.

ctx.x: So we were sitting in this hall, and the Frenchmen, you know they get very upset if things don’t go according to plan. So they started to get restless and we were sitting there waiting on the music, and all of a sudden it got very loud out there, you know? And Basie said “I think we better get the hell out of here” you know. And we had to slip out a side door because we thought those people were going to attack us, you know, I don’t think they believed that we didn’t have any — somebody went out there and…
It took that long for the stuff to catch up with the band.
